title: 22 St John Street: August project report
body: Final joinery is complete and the first show apartment has been handed over to the sales team. The scheme remains on programme for handover in the autumn.

tasks.title: Show apartment handover
tasks.detail: Joinery, decoration and furnishing complete; handed to the sales team on 6 August.

tasks.title: Suite fit-out, levels two and three
tasks.detail: Second fix under way across six suites, with commissioning to follow in September.

tasks.title: Common parts and entrance
tasks.detail: Stone flooring laid; lighting and signage scheduled for the first week of September.

title: Barnett House: August project report
body: The building is now weather-tight. First-fix MEP is progressing across levels two to five, and the programme is unchanged.

tasks.title: Building envelope
tasks.detail: Roof, glazing and cladding complete; the building is weather-tight.

tasks.title: First-fix MEP, levels two to five
tasks.detail: Containment and risers installed to level four, with level five following this month.

tasks.title: Cost report
tasks.detail: Contract sum unchanged. Provisional sums for the entrance remain open pending final design.

title: Court House: July project report
body: The full planning submission has been validated and public consultation is under way. Pre-construction procurement continues in parallel.

tasks.title: Planning submission
tasks.detail: Validated by the local authority; consultation period runs to late August.

tasks.title: Contractor procurement
tasks.detail: Two-stage tender issued to a shortlist of three; returns expected in September.

tasks.title: Funding
tasks.detail: Senior terms agreed in principle, subject to a satisfactory planning outcome.

title: Chester House: July project report
body: The project team has reconfirmed practical completion for September following the latest programme review, keeping the scheme ahead of the original date.

tasks.title: Programme review
tasks.detail: Practical completion reconfirmed for September, three weeks ahead of the original date.

tasks.title: Apartment fit-out
tasks.detail: Kitchens and bathrooms installed to the first and second floors; snagging begins in August.

tasks.title: Sales and marketing
tasks.detail: Reservations open, with viewings handled directly by the Satis Group team.

title: Davenport Park: July project report
body: The concrete frame has reached level three and blockwork is following two floors behind. The tower crane comes down in early October.

tasks.title: Superstructure
tasks.detail: Frame at level three; remaining pours scheduled through August and September.

tasks.title: Blockwork
tasks.detail: Following two floors behind the frame, with no reported labour constraints.

tasks.title: Crane off hire
tasks.detail: Tower crane dismantle booked for the first week of October.

title: Barrington Road: July project report
body: Ground works are complete and the substructure is signed off, clearing the way for the frame to start on site.

tasks.title: Ground works
tasks.detail: Excavation, drainage and foundations complete and signed off by the engineer.

tasks.title: Superstructure start
tasks.detail: Frame package let; first deliveries to site in the last week of July.

tasks.title: Cost report
tasks.detail: Ground works settled within the allowance, with no drawdown on contingency.
